zh-CN.title: 语音转写衔接更顺滑
items: 转写续页现在会继承气泡圆角，并与连续消息自然衔接
展开和收起都有完整动效，个性化预览也可以直接测试转文字效果

en.title: Smoother voice transcript continuity
items: Transcript continuations now inherit bubble corners and connect naturally with grouped messages
Both opening and closing are animated, and transcripts can now be tested in personalization previews
